description: Source code for Vulkan-based quantization and dequantization operations in PyTorch, including functions for quantizing tensors per tensor, dequantizing, and related utilities.

methods.name: get_quantize_per_tensor_shader
methods.description: Selects the appropriate Vulkan shader for quantization based on tensor dtype.

methods.name: quantize_per_tensor
methods.description: Quantizes a tensor per tensor using Vulkan compute shader.

methods.name: quantize_per_tensor_tensor_qparams
methods.description: Quantizes a tensor with provided scale and zero point tensors.

methods.name: dequantize_helper
methods.description: Helper function to dequantize a tensor using Vulkan compute shader.

methods.name: q_scale
methods.description: Retrieves the scale of a Vulkan quantized tensor.

methods.name: q_zero_point
methods.description: Retrieves the zero point of a Vulkan quantized tensor.

methods.name: dequantize
methods.description: Dequantizes a Vulkan quantized tensor to float.
